lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso; spacing is wider on the anterior section and becomes significantly denser toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Visible abbreviated line segments on the upper and mid-posterior torso that terminate before reaching the ventral or dorsal boundaries.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster consisting of 4 distinct white spots located on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-thigh exhibit a semi-linear horizontal alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white chevron on the bridge of the nose, dual white spots on the cheek region, and a distinct white horizontal band on the anterior distal portion of the front limb.
